sampling.nejm: All five other supplied publisher-Perspective copies, 2017–2019; do not substitute editorials or empirical studies.
sampling.hbr: Seven retained complete publisher-form practitioner essays, before 2015; screen identity/body completeness and document exclusions.
sampling.systematic: Eight deterministic length-rank choices from the earlier 113 pre-2015 screened XML candidates; retain any false positives, do not replace based on scaffold fit.

units: printed section or explicitly interpreted unheaded movement

coding.functions: Existing twelve IDs; multiple per paragraph; unresolved allowed; labels are model interpretations.
coding.section_roles: Separate printed headings from analyst roles; source-specific roles preserved.
coding.independence: Second coder receives source text/context and codebook without first-coder labels. Report agreement and disagreements, not consensus by assumption.

statistics.presence: Count distinct documents with observed feature, always report numerator and denominator. Presence anywhere does not establish ordered template.
statistics.length: Shared metrics.py tokenizer. Report min/q1/median/q3/max and document/paragraph counts. For function lengths show pooled tagged-paragraph observations AND per-document medians to expose weighting.
statistics.section_lengths: Retain each named section and disjoint paragraph membership. Matched roles may be summarized only within cohort; an unheaded move is not a printed section.
statistics.overlap: A multi-label paragraph contributes its entire length to each function distribution; these distributions are not additive word budgets.
statistics.limits: Observed extrema are not hard limits; no automatic working targets, grade levels or causal quality claims.
statistics.uncertainty: Single-analyst reconstruction limitations; rare-function samples and narrow venues/eras explicit. No population confidence intervals from this convenience sample.

completion: Report fully read/coded and quantifiable scope separately from selective passages, incomplete copies and unvalidated candidates.
